snippet.title: Curse of Resthaven | MIX Summer Game Showcase Trailer
snippet.description:
Trailer premiered as part of the The MIX Summer Games Showcase 2026. CoR is a narrative roguelite coming soon from developer Hilltop Studios, published by Digital Bandidos. 

Take command of the cursed island colony Resthaven after your niece disappears on the eve of a catastrophe. You must govern the town, allocate resources wisely, and decide who – or what – to trust. Investigate, interrogate, trade, upgrade, and embark upon card-based expeditions to uncover dark secrets.

At the end of your seventh day, the island is destroyed… but a fading goddess sends you back to the moment of your arrival. Your destiny is clear: Can you break the curse?

▶ Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3796150/Curse_of_Resthaven/
▶ Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/playhilltop.bsky.social
▶ Twitter: https://x.com/PlayHilltop

Coming soon to PC, Mac, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and Nintendo Switch

#CurseOfResthaven
